about: Read by config.routes(). A leg runs on its phase's model and effort (phases.json) unless a route here names its role and phase, and its unit when the route lists units. model: opus or sonnet. A route is a trial until the owner says it stays.

routes.why: trial, the owner 2026-10-08: can a review fix be executed on Sonnet. Only the model changes: the effort is the phase's, the plan leg stays on Opus, and every review-fix unit gets the same role text. The ten units are every second one of the first twenty in the queue's order on 2026-10-08; the other ten (rv-13, rv-15, rv-11b, rv-c1, rv2-01, rv-04, rv-06, rv-08, rv-16, rv-18) run on Opus beside them as the control. Measured per unit by the fix check of the review lane (fixcheck), the unit's verdict, minutes and cost.
